text:
dina: IR needs 60-90 days of host + auth logs for tenant t-77 for an incident. Tenant doesn't have extended retention. Can we do a time-limited export to our SIEM? Need KMS handling + RBAC controls.

owen: Yes. Submit SEC-4477. We use a timeboxed export role and rewrapped key flow.

li: Suggested flow:
- open SEC-4477 with tenant owner ack
- create temp role `siem-exporter:t-77` with read-only on tenant logs
- run export job to `s3://exports/redwood/t-77/SEC-4477/`
- KMS: GenerateDataKey, encrypt with customer KMS, store wrapped key in vault, hand off wrapped key + presigned URLs to vendor
- TTL: role and bucket lifecycle to auto-delete after 7 days

sec-bot: Check: tenant opt-in false. Blocked until exec or privacy approval.

dina: Can we make oncall step a single CLI? e.g. `rw infra export --tenant t-77 --days 90 --ticket SEC-4477` and backend enforces approvals.

owen: We already have an internal endpoint that requires ticket and approvers. It returns `export_id` and wrapped key blob.

li: Note: prefer unwrap-proxy rather than sending plaintext keys. Vendor can unwrap only if contract+attestation exist.

sec-bot: Created tasks: SEC-4477-1 (create temp role), SEC-4477-2 (KMS wrap + vault), SEC-4477-3 (run export + SIEM ingest test).

dina: I'll open the ticket and ping privacy.
